task.title: Clear Cookies and Cache
task.shortdesc: Learn how to clear your device’s cookies and cache from Chrome.

taskbody.prereq: To clear your cookies and cache from Microsoft Edge and Safari, see the links below.
taskbody.context: How to clear your cache and cookies.

steps.step:
At the top right,
select “More” (three vertical dots) and then “Delete browsing data.”

step.cmd: Select cookies and other site data.
Check other items you want to delete.
